page.layout: Two columns of Greek text on the left-hand side, with a heading and a woodcut initial in the lower left section. Two columns of Greek text on the right. Letters A to H in the central margin, between the columns. Running head at top centre. Page number at top left. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: παῦτα ὅτι λευκόν, οὐδὲν ἄλλο ... [illegible, ~60 letters] ... ὡς ἐλέγξῃ;
main_text.head: ΠΕΡΙ ΓΟΡΓΙΟΥ.
Κεφάλαιον ε.
main_text.p: AΓ' Κ εἶναι φησιν οὐδὲν· εἰ δ' ἔστιν, ἀγνωστον ἐστιν· εἰ δὲ καὶ ἔστι καὶ γνωστόν, ἀλλ' οὐ σημαίνοντα ἄλλο. [illegible, ~80 letters] ... ὡς ἐλέγξῃ, ὡς ἔστιν.
main_text.head: Κεφάλαιον ς.
main_text.p: BΟὐ γὰρ συμβαίνει ἐξ ὧν εἴρηκεν, οὕτως ἐξ ἀλέγεται· [illegible, ~300 letters]

page.notes: The page is set in Greek with accents and breathings. At this scan resolution I could read only the headings (ΠΕΡΙ ΓΟΡΓΙΟΥ, Κεφάλαιον ε. and ς.), the catchword ἈΝΕΜΩΝ, the opening words of the Gorgias section and the margin letters A to H. The body text of both columns is largely illegible and is marked as such rather than guessed. The margin letters are printed in the central gutter and are treated as side notes; the exact position of each letter is approximate. The top right faint "LIB. DE" is show-through and was left out. The first line of the left column is a fragment carried over from the previous page.
